answer: The whisper lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the crystal is where a second reviewer recomputes them. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the river of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, weighted by independent path length, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
